saveRepeatedLists.question: Can clinics save monthly or repeated purchase lists?

ordersQuotes.title: Orders & Quotes
ordersQuotes.description: Understand when to place an order, request a quote, and where to follow up.

quoteBeforeOrdering.question: Can I request a quote before ordering?
quoteBeforeOrdering.answer: Yes. You can request a quote before placing an order, especially for bulk quantities, clinic purchases, or products that need price confirmation.

trackQuotes.question: Where can I track my quote requests?
trackQuotes.answer: You can track your quote requests from your account under the Quotes section.

orderVsQuote.question: What is the difference between placing an order and requesting a quote?
orderVsQuote.answer: Placing an order is used when you are ready to buy with the listed product details. Requesting a quote is useful when you need pricing confirmation, bulk pricing, or special product availability review.

supplyLists.title: Supply Lists
supplyLists.description: Learn how saved lists can make repeated clinic purchasing faster.

saveRepeatedLists.question: Can clinics save monthly or repeated purchase lists?
saveRepeatedLists.answer: Yes. Clinics can create Supply Lists to save frequently purchased products and reorder them faster in the future.

whatIsSupplyList.question: What is a Supply List?
whatIsSupplyList.answer: A Supply List is a saved list of products that a clinic may need regularly, such as monthly essentials or repeated clinic supplies.

cartToSupplyList.question: Can I add products from my cart to a Supply List?
cartToSupplyList.answer: Yes. You can save cart items as a reusable Supply List for faster future ordering.

productRequests.title: Product Requests
productRequests.description: See how to request an unlisted product and track the request in your account.

unlistedProduct.question: Can I request a product that is not listed on the website?
unlistedProduct.answer: Yes. If a product is not listed, you can send a product request with the product name, brand, or details so the team can review it.

unavailableProduct.question: What happens if a product is unavailable?
unavailableProduct.answer: You can submit a product request. The request will be sent to the company for review, and the team can later reply with availability or alternatives.

requestsInAccount.question: Will product requests appear in my account?
requestsInAccount.answer: Yes. Product requests should appear in your account as sent requests so you can track them. Full email/chat handling will be connected during the backend phase.

accountSupport.title: Account & Support
accountSupport.description: Find out which clinic tools need an account and how to reach support.

accountRequired.question: Do I need an account to use clinic tools?
accountRequired.answer: Yes. Account features such as quotes, supply lists, product requests, wishlist, and order tracking require signing in.

contactSupport.question: Where can I contact support?
contactSupport.answer: You can contact support from the Contact page using the available phone, WhatsApp, or support options.
